question: Himank starts from Point A and drives 13 km towards West. He then takes a left turn, drives 3 km, turns left and drives 16 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 6 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Himank starts from Point A and drives 13 km towards West.

He then takes a left turn, drives 3 km, turns left and drives 16 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 6 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P.
